segs: A busy production floor isn't always a profitable one.
How much material slips away without you knowing?
If you still count inventory on paper, you're not alone.
And counting by hand steals your nights.
With OneTap, every production run uses its bill of materials and deducts raw materials from stock.
With lots and traceability across warehouses.
And every morning, you know what to reorder before you run out.
First month free. No card required.
